change: CommonMark Java — Keep inline code in an image’s accessible name
deployment: Pinned source-built commonmark core, including its entity resource.
assumptions: Fresh parser and renderer, one retained syntax tree, XHTML fragment decoded with the JDK, one in-place Code literal edit.

questions.observer: Read the image URL, decoded accessible name, escaped HTML attribute and code outside the image before and after editing the original tree.
questions.basis: A code node contributes its current literal to the accessible name on the fix. The HTML writer escapes ampersands exactly once.

inputs.after: cover.png/foo bar/foo bar/outside|cover.png/edit & again bar/edit & again bar/outside

questions.observer: Render text, emphasis and a link in the image label, and edit the external code on the same tree.
questions.basis: Inline text content contributes to this label on both releases. The edit affects only the external code.

inputs.before: cover.png/plain bold link/plain bold link/outside|cover.png/plain bold link/plain bold link/outside & edited
